title: Proposing a short version of the Unesp-Botucatu pig acute pain scale using a novel application of machine learning technique.
summary: The primary study uses random-forest feature selection to propose a shorter pig acute-pain scale and evaluates it against painful/pain-free states; this is a specific veterinary measurement result, not evidence of improved animal outcomes.
